description: MVP demonstration curriculum. Course names are referenced in the project research paper; descriptions, outcomes and assessments below are minimal sample text for deterministic mapping only, not official university syllabus content.

provenance.course_name_source: Xi Xi n11507152.docx, Sections 3.4 and 4, which name IFN712 Research in IT Practice and IFN711 Industry Project.

courses.description: A demo research-practice course using data analysis to investigate an IT problem and communicate evidence-based findings.
learning_outcomes: Apply data analysis to investigate a defined IT practice problem.
Communicate research findings and limitations to a technical audience.
Plan a small research activity and present an evidence-based report.

courses.description: A demo team industry project course centred on software development, project management, team collaboration and communication.
learning_outcomes: Plan and deliver a team software development project.
Apply project management to organise project work and milestones.
Demonstrate team collaboration and communication with project stakeholders.
assessments: Project management plan and final presentation.
